name: Martin Sigler
about: Martin Sigler is a Berlin-based writer specialising in culture, philosophy and identity. His work focuses on the everyday, proposing pragmatic approaches to ways in which the Black individual can emancipate themselves in a postcolonial context. After completing a Masters degree in Culture, Criticism and Curation at Central Saint Martins, he designed and self-published I Am the Performative Object, a book exploring the articulation between performative objects and the construction of a Black identity.
